overview: The Resonance Core powers the entire Vex Thal megastructure.
details: Voidstone reactors channel alien energy through resonance conduits, stabilized by temporal anchors. Xi Thall engineers maintain the core while voidborn entities gather around its power.
hooks: A voidstone reactor destabilizes, threatening a cascade failure.
Temporal anchors flicker, altering the flow of time within the core.
A Xi Thall engineer awakens from deep stasis.
Voidborn cores manifest near overloaded conduits.
